item.title: Alkegen launches new mobile app
item.description: Alkegen launched the Alkegen App for iOS and Android, providing instant access to safety and product data sheets, plus 24/7 customer support chat and user feedback tools for streamlined assistance.

item.title: Shell invests $5M in Southern University to expand STEM and student success
item.description: Shell is investing $5 million in Southern University to expand STEM education, enhance its chemical engineering program and strengthen Louisiana’s future industrial workforce.

item.title: Foundation awards grants to 388 nonprofits
item.description: The Dominion Energy Charitable Foundation awarded $3.5M to 388 nonprofits, including 208 in Virginia, supporting education, housing, veterans and food access across its service areas.

item.title: Duke Energy awards nearly $275K to help fight hunger in South Carolina
item.description: Duke Energy and the Duke Energy Foundation awarded over $600,000 in South Carolina to fight food insecurity, including surprise microgrants and support for groups like Harvest Hope Food Bank.

item.title: Marathon Petroleum boosts El Paso Giving Day Success
item.description: Marathon Petroleum Corp.’s El Paso refinery boosted El Paso Giving Day with matching grants to 10 nonprofits, helping raise $2.3M and surpass the $2.1M goal, according to Paso del Norte Community Foundation.

item.title: Wearable tech: A practical layer of protection for O&G operations
item.description: O&G has never lacked technology. What it has always demanded is technology that performs under real-world conditions — heat, noise, complex machinery and constant exposure risk.
